nodes.description: A preclinical, investigational direction only. In FBXO11-deficient human iPSC-derived neurons and in Drosophila, proteasome-activating substances — including the long-approved drug verapamil — ameliorated FBXO11-deficiency phenotypes, suggesting that boosting proteasomal degradation could compensate for reduced SCF(FBXO11) activity. This has not been tested in patients and is not an established therapy.
